title: Geometry-Analysis-Certificate triangle
statement: Read every phenomenon through geometry, analysis, and certificate.

title: Observable anatomy
statement: Every arithmetic function is checked through structure/geometry/average/normal order/limiting law/tail/moments/maximal order/wall/certificate before any claim.

title: Test phase before randomness
statement: Test the pretentious/Halasz phase before claiming cancellation or randomness of a multiplicative function.

title: Average is not normal order
statement: Average order, normal order, concentration, and cancellation are distinct tests; do not infer one from another.
